summary: Iteration 6 — Tested new features: password reset (forgot/reset endpoints + dev_link fallback), Cloudinary signature (missing-config 400 + member 403), pdf_url seed on 'Analisis Data dengan Python', PDF viewer modal in UI, and BookEditor Cloudinary upload flow. All 22 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend flows verified end-to-end via Playwright.

issues: Demo pdf_url (www.w3.org/.../dummy.pdf) sets X-Frame-Options: sameorigin and cannot render in the iframe. Console shows: 'Refused to display in a frame'. The 'Buka di tab baru' fallback works. Consider replacing seed pdf_url with an iframe-friendly host (e.g., https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/web/viewer.html?file=... or a Cloudinary-hosted PDF) so the inline viewer actually shows content in demo mode.

action_items: Optional UX polish: replace the demo pdf_url (currently https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf) with a PDF host that permits iframe embedding, so the inline PDF viewer renders content in demo mode. Functionally the app is correct; only the 3rd-party asset blocks the iframe.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is nearing 830 lines — consider splitting auth/books/loans into modules for maintainability.
_send_reset_email uses asyncio.to_thread(resend.Emails.send, ...) which is fine; ensure resend package is pinned in requirements.txt (verified: import works).
password_reset_tokens uses TTL index on expires_at (create_index expireAfterSeconds=0) — good, expired tokens will be auto-purged.
Consider rate-limiting /api/auth/forgot-password to prevent abuse (currently unlimited).
